div.div:
Orange = geofluid loop (H2O), teal = secondary R245fa loop. Purple ① ② = where tango and RAFT exchange boundary conditions each pass; grey = how each timestep's passes converge.
tango sets the loop's mass flow and temperature at the injection wellhead and its pressure at the production wellhead (target_extraction_pressure); RAFT solves for the injection pressure, which the surface plant then delivers.

text.tspan: Orange = geofluid loop (H2O), teal = secondary R245fa loop. Purple ① ② = where tango and RAFT exchange boundary conditions each pass; grey = how each timestep's passes converge.

tango sets the loop's mass flow and temperature at the injection wellhead and its pressure at the production wellhead (target_extraction_pressure); RAFT solves for the injection pressure, which the surface plant then delivers.

RAFT — geg_raft.api.RaftModel (raft: block → RaftWrapper)
one well + surrounding 3D rock, finite elements; template templates/raft/ (NR_tol 1e-8)

get_fresh(): accept the last trial, once per timestep
records: inlet/outlet values, solve_stats, well_profiles()

div.div:
① Injection wellhead (RAFT's well inlet)
tango → RAFT: mass flow = sim_config.mass_rate (flux BC); temperature from the surface outlet's h at the last P_inj (temperature BC)
RAFT → tango: P_inj, the injection pressure RAFT solves for
→ SystemBCIteration calls surface.set_injection_pressure(P_inj) right after the loop solves, so circulation_control delivers it in the same pass

text.tspan: tango → RAFT: mass flow = sim_config.mass_rate (flux BC); temperature from
the surface outlet's h at the last P_inj (temperature BC)
RAFT → tango: P_inj, the injection pressure RAFT solves for
→ SystemBCIteration calls surface.set_injection_pressure(P_inj) right after the
loop solves, so circulation_control delivers it in the same pass

div.div:
② Production wellhead (RAFT's well outlet)
tango → RAFT: pressure = sim_config.target_extraction_pressure (pressure BC)
RAFT → tango: T_out (→ h_out with tango's fluid properties) and the outlet mass flow
→ the loop's outlet stream (h_out, P = target, mass_rate) is the surface plant's inlet

text.tspan: RAFT → tango: T_out (→ h_out with tango's fluid properties) and the outlet
→ the loop's outlet stream (h_out, P = target, mass_rate) is the surface plant's

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 249, 250), rgb(22, 23, 24)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(95, 99, 104), rgb(150, 153, 157));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 510px; height: 1px; padding-top: 525px; margin-left: 798px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Each timestep (SystemBCIteration)
1. restore every component to the end of the previous timestep
2. one pass: grouped_subsurface (one RAFT trial; ① ②), then the surface plant
3. converged when the surface outlet's h matches the h the loop solved from (|Δh| < 1 kJ/kg) and P_inj has settled (|ΔP| < 1 kPa); else Aitken-relaxed h, next pass (up to 20)
4. accept: RAFT keeps the last trial (get_fresh), everything is recorded

text.tspan: 1. restore every component to the end of the previous timestep
2. one pass: grouped_subsurface (one RAFT trial; ① ②), then the surface plant
3. converged when the surface outlet's h matches the h the loop solved from (|Δh| < 1 kJ/kg) and P_inj has settled
(|ΔP| < 1 kPa); else Aitken-relaxed h, next pass (up to 20)
4. accept: RAFT keeps the last trial (get_fresh), everything is recorded
